Plan written. Only `.ralph/` was touched (plus a running probe server I killed).

**What the investigation found**

- **Docker/WS is fine.** I booted the built artefacts exactly as the image does (`STATIC_DIR=dist/client node dist-server/index.js`) and drove them with headless Chromium: handshake, `auth_ok`, `join_system`, 10 Hz `entity_update` and warp all work. No `app/Dockerfile` change is planned.
- **The warp error is a client bug.** `app/src/client/App.tsx` puts `shell` (a value object re-created on every menu-stack change) in the client-wiring effect's deps, so opening the chart/menu/dock panel re-runs the effect and its cleanup calls `client.stop()`. Reproduced on the prod build: pressing `M` flipped status `online → disconnected` instantly. `tests/e2e/warp.spec.ts` is **red today** for this reason (regression from TASK-53, `95504a2`).
- **The starry background is a missing feature.** Nothing in `src/client` ever constructs a `THREE.WebGLRenderer` or `Scene`; `CanvasStage.tsx` is still the TASK-70 starfield stub, no key path reaches `sendInput`, and `DriftClient` has no `predictor`, so the ship HUD is empty too.

**New tasks (appended after TASK-69; 1–71 untouched and all still `passes: true`)**

| id | what it delivers |
|---|---|
| TASK-72 | Fix the menu-surface socket teardown; extract `useClientWiring`; make `warp.spec.ts` green |
| TASK-73 | Render host: three.js renderer + scene + CameraRig + instrumented rAF loop (starfield ported) |
| TASK-74 | Own ship: predicted state + ship mesh + WASD/QE/Space/Shift flight input + new `"external"` chase camera |
| TASK-75 | Pooled remote-entity meshes (players, AI, wrecks, drones, props) with snapshot interpolation |
| TASK-76 | Seeded star + planets derived from the shared galaxy generators and the `/api/health` seed |
| TASK-77 | Production-path Playwright gate (build → `node dist-server/index.js`, no `.env.local`) + README/ops docs |

`.ralph/prd/PRD.md` gains §13 with the evidence, requirements R-1…R-8, non-goals (on-foot meshes, terrain streaming, combat FX, mobile perf) and acceptance criteria; `.ralph/STEERING.md` now names the red warp spec and points at TASK-72.
